[[Svoge]] | capacity = 3,500 | chairman = Petar Veselinov| executive director = | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Zahari Sirakov]] | league = [[Second Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|Second League]] | season = [[2025–26 Second Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|2025–26]]| position = Second League, 13th of 17| website = {{URL|https://sportist-svoge.net/}}| pattern_la1=_whiteborder|pattern_b1=_collarwhite|pattern_ra1=_whiteborder | leftarm1= 436FFF |body1= 436FFF |rightarm1= 436FFF |shorts1= 436FFF |socks1= 436FFF | pattern_la2=|pattern_b2=|pattern_ra2= | leftarm2= 000000 |body2= 000000 |rightarm2= 000000 |shorts2= 000000 |socks2= 000000 }} '''FC Sportist''' ({{langx|bg|ФК Спортист}}) is a [[Bulgaria]]n [[football club]] based in [[Svoge]], which currently competes in the [[Second Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|Second League]], the second tier of Bulgarian football, following promotion from the Third League. The club was founded in 1924 and their home ground is the [[Stadion Chavdar Tsvetkov]], which has a [[seating capacity]] of 3,500 spectators. The club's biggest success is promotion to the [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|Bulgarian top division]] in 2009, although they were relegated at the end of the [[2009–10 A Group|2009-10 season]]. The club plays home games in blue and white kits."}}
